_about: Coins (Shaked, 2026-10-22): earned by strong answers, spent in the shop and in duels. No monetary value, never bought, never cashed out. Every number here is a decision of Shaked's; change the file, not the code. 2026-11-06 (Shaked: 'i dont want so many coins'): a strong practice answer earns 5, flat (no hard-question bonus), a strong interview turn 10, and a question pays ONCE per user: a second strong answer on the same question, in practice or in an interview, earns nothing. XP is gone.
_about_again: Shaked, 2026-11-14 ('weak attempt followed by a strong one should get less coins (maybe 2), but after a strong one you dont get more coins on that question until some time will pass'). This replaces 'a question pays once': the full amount (5 in practice, 10 in an interview) is for a strong FIRST answer on a question. A strong answer after an earlier, not strong, attempt on the same question earns strong_answer_again. A question that was paid pays nothing for again_after_days (21 = three weeks, the point at which the plan asks for a skill to be refreshed), and after that a strong answer earns strong_answer_again. A reference revealed on any attempt still means no coins on that question.
_about_interview_finish: Shaked, 2026-11-07 ('rewarded by the ability to finish it and the ability to have strong answers; coins will become real money'): finishing an interview pays a bonus equal to this share of what its strong turns earned (first-time questions only), when it ran to its end with at least interview_finished_min_turns answers. 1.0 = finishing doubles the interview's earnings; ended early, too few answers or no strong answer = nothing. Nothing here can be earned without a strong first-time answer.

quiz._about: American questions from seeds/duel_quiz.json: five a duel, a minute each at most (Shaked, 2026-10-22)

pool._about: the judged mode only. What counts as a short question: the live bank has no question under three minutes by its own estimate and every live question is difficulty 5, so 'short' is a format a person answers in a few sentences. Grows as Harel's short questions reach the bank.

description.en: Raises today's question limit by ten. Tomorrow the plan's limit is back.
description.he: מעלה את מכסת השאלות של היום בעשר. מחר המכסה של התוכנית חוזרת.
